why: A function header continued with `...` before its `=` is the header under CRLF as under LF (MATLAB doc 'Continue Long Statements on Multiple Lines'), so `dfit`'s `feval` of its parameter `regr` calls the function its caller passes there, `regA` (MATLAB doc 'feval'; matlab-argument-flow.test.ts 'links a feval of a parameter to each function the callers pass, a name looked up where the sink is, a handle where it was written'), and `regr` is no call. This guards the argument synthesis, which parses the file again and must read it as the extractor does (step 12: CRLF reads as LF); the step turns the file to LF and nothing changes.
